what: Fires once when the top edge of the card group crosses the 60% line from the top of the screen. Cell by cell in .1s turns, each cell that sat 50px lower in grayscale at .1 opacity rises, with opacity over .3s and position and color over .5s using cubic-bezier(.39,.575,.565,1), taking on color as it goes

options.ratio: At what fraction from the top of the screen the line is crossed and it stands, default .6
options.each: Delay between cells (s), default .1 — 0 means all at once
options.y: Sink depth (px), default 50 (original fund cover version 60)

from.where: index.html level cards, new posts, tool cells — original .top-money-columns__unit etc. (opacity .1 · grayscale(1) · translateY(50px) → .3s · .5s · .5s, --01·--02·--03 are 0·.1·.2s)
